description: The bar chart illustrates the CoLeG-R (%) performance across different models and conditions, with the horizontal axis listing the models LLama-2-7B, LLama-2-13B, and LLama-2-70B, and the vertical axis representing CoLeG-R (%) ranging from 10 to 80. Each model has four bars corresponding to different conditions: "no SFT" (light blue), "+ SFT on D₀" (light orange), "+ SFT on D₀, D₁" (light purple), and "+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂" (light red). For each model, the performance generally increases with additional SFT stages, with the highest performance observed for LLama-2-70B under the "+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂" condition, reaching approximately 85%. The lowest performance is observed for LLama-2-7B under the "no SFT" condition, around 68%. The bars are grouped by model, with the conditions consistently ordered from left to right across all models.
